title: Marin filter column
description: Everything an app's filter column says and holds. An app lists its filters in filters.json; the shell draws the column. The words "Filter", "Search" and "Reset", the order, the spacing, the scrolling and the accessibility are the shell's and cannot be set here.

search.description: The search box, first when there is one. Leave it out for a short list that needs none. Its label is always "Search" and it never has a placeholder, so neither can be set.

fields.description: The record fields the search reads, as dot paths. With these the column can match records itself.

match.description: "phrase" (default): the whole search must appear in the text. "words": every word must appear, in any order.

address.description: false keeps every choice out of the address bar (a table's own filter). Default true.

id.description: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Becomes the id of the control and part of its saved state.

label.description: The group's visible title: a plural noun such as "Departments", starting with a capital, with no colon and not starting with "Filter".

allLabel.description: What the group says when nothing is chosen: "All" and the group's plural noun, such as "All departments".

options.description: Where the choices come from. Prefer "from": the labels then come from the app's own data file, not from this file.

from.description: A data file path, relative to the app.

records.description: Where the list of records sits in the file, as a dot path such as "data.jobs". Leave out when the file is the list.

valueField.description: The record field whose values become the choices. A field holding a list gives one choice for each item.

labelField.description: The record field shown for each choice. Defaults to the value field.

parentField.description: The record field that holds the value of another record in the same list: that record is listed under it (a division under its department). Choosing one does not choose the other.

order.description: "data" keeps the choices in the order the file lists them; the default sorts them A to Z (numbers in order).

hidden.description: A choice that is not listed but can be set by the app (for example a "Report dates" time range). Only for a radio group or a drop-down.

oneOf.description: The app supplies the choices itself after it loads (data it fetched or worked out): column.setOptions(groupId, [{value, label, count?}]). The group's name and "All" text still come from this file.

checkboxGroup.description: Checkboxes. Collapsed by default into a group whose summary reads allLabel, or "N selected". With collapsed false the checkboxes are always showing, with no summary, for a short list such as the measures to show.

collapsed.description: false shows every checkbox with no summary. Default true.

default.description: Values checked on load and after Reset.

separator.description: Read and write the choices as one address parameter joined with this character ("a,b"), as an app's older shared links did. Without it each choice is its own parameter.

field.description: The record field this group matches against, as a dot path ("themes", "venue.name"). A field holding a list counts as each of its values. Leave it out when the app applies the group itself (a time range, a tab).

radioGroup.description: A choice of one shown as radio buttons, not collapsed. One value is always chosen.

default.description: The value chosen on load and after Reset. A value, or "latest" for the newest choice in the data.

field.description: The record field this group matches against, as a dot path ("themes", "venue.name"). A field holding a list counts as each of its values. Leave it out when the app applies the group itself (a time range, a tab).

selectGroup.description: A choice of one in a drop-down, not collapsed. allLabel adds a first, empty choice that means everything; a drop-down with no such choice (a time range) sets default instead.

default.description: The value chosen on load and after Reset, or "latest".

field.description: The record field this group matches against, as a dot path ("themes", "venue.name"). A field holding a list counts as each of its values. Leave it out when the app applies the group itself (a time range, a tab).

dateRangeGroup.description: A From date and a To date. The two labels are always "From" and "To".

fromParam.description: The address parameter for the From date, when links already used one ("from"). Default: the group's param and "-from".

toParam.description: The address parameter for the To date ("to"). Default: the group's param and "-to".

field.description: The record field this group matches against, as a dot path ("themes", "venue.name"). A field holding a list counts as each of its values. Leave it out when the app applies the group itself (a time range, a tab).

nestedCheckboxGroup.description: Checkboxes inside collapsed groups, from a data file: one group for each value of the first groupBy field, and inside it one for each value of the second. Groups appear in the order the data first shows them; the summary adds "(N selected)".

groupBy.description: The record fields that name the groups, outermost first.

parentField.description: The record field that holds the value of another record in the same list: that record is listed under it (a division under its department). Choosing one does not choose the other.

order.description: "data" keeps the choices in the order the file lists them; the default sorts them A to Z (numbers in order).

separator.description: Read and write the choices as one address parameter joined with this character ("a,b"), as an app's older shared links did. Without it each choice is its own parameter.

field.description: The record field this group matches against, as a dot path ("themes", "venue.name"). A field holding a list counts as each of its values. Leave it out when the app applies the group itself (a time range, a tab).

appOptions.description: The app supplies the choices itself after it loads (data it fetched or worked out): column.setOptions(groupId, [{value, label, count?}]). The group's name and "All" text still come from this file.
